summary: Verified admin search bar + Google rating fields end-to-end. Backend 14/14 pytest passing (categories, workshops list/detail/featured/search, comunas, plus new test_admin_rating.py covering create/update/default rating & review_count, PUT auth, cleanup). Frontend (390x844 web preview): admin login (contacto@vitrinaautomotriz.cl / 1713132) reaches admin-dashboard; admin-search filters list and shows subtitle 'X de Y talleres' (observed '1 de 69 talleres'); admin-empty shown for no-match term; admin-search-clear resets. Tapping admin-edit-{id} opens admin-form pre-filled with rating (f-rating='4.9') and review count (f-reviews='201') for Frenos Seguros; the section 'Puntuación en Google' renders above f-rating/f-reviews. Created workshop ZZZ_UITEST_* with f-rating=4.3 & f-reviews=27 via UI → GET /api/workshops/{id} returns rating=4.3, review_count=27 (persisted). Editing rating to 3.7 also persisted. Regression: Home tab, Mapa tab (mapa-screen), Turbo FAB, Categorías/Favoritos/Info tabs load fine. Note: the workshop DB now has 68 non-TEST workshops (real admin-added data) plus 12 seeds → totaling ~69 — subtitle format works with real data.

react_native_issues.issue: After router.replace('/admin') from admin/form, both admin-dashboard elements remain in DOM (one hidden, one visible). Selectors like [data-testid=admin-delete-{id}] resolve to 2 elements; Playwright picks the hidden one and fails. Functional impact: none for real users (touch hits visible one), but flaky in automated tests. Consider unmounting/replacing stack or unique testIDs per mount. Reference: /app/frontend/app/admin/index.tsx and /app/frontend/app/admin/form.tsx (router.replace usage).

action_items: None required for the reported features — search + rating fields work correctly and persist. Optional: add explicit unmount / use router.replace with 'reset: true' or Stack.Screen options to fully drop admin index when navigating to form so testIDs are unique.
critical_code_review_comments: admin/index.tsx: search filter is client-side and uses useMemo over name/comuna/category (case-insensitive). Matches requirement.
admin/form.tsx: rating input validates 0–5 range with comma→dot normalization; review_count strips non-digits. Good defensive parsing.
server.py: WorkshopCreate accepts rating (default 4.5) and review_count (default 0); POST/PUT persist both. Response excludes _id via projection.
server.py: PUT uses full replace of provided fields via $set(payload.dict()), which correctly updates rating/review_count and everything else.
seed_data_creation: Created one test workshop ZZZ_UITEST_* via UI to verify persistence; deleted via API afterwards (verified 404).
